experiments.name: Multi-Benchmark Grand Evaluation across Ladder
experiments.falsifies_if: SurvTD fails to beat CoxSig and TCSR by at least 0.03 C-index across continuous benchmarks.

experiments.name: Continuous-to-Discrete Discretization Ablation
experiments.falsifies_if: Forcing discrete uniform discretization Delta t = 1.0 produces equal or superior C-index and Brier score compared to continuous Cramér projection.

experiments.name: Projection Non-Expansiveness and Metric Stress Test
experiments.falsifies_if: Cramér distance loss diverges or fails to decrease monotonically under continuous interval variations.

experiments.name: Lambda-Spectrum Bias-Variance Tradeoff Sweep
experiments.falsifies_if: Performance does not exhibit an inverted-U curve with optimal lambda between 0.4 and 0.8, or lambda = 1.0 does not degrade concordance.

experiments.name: Compute-Matched Baseline Ladder Comparison
experiments.falsifies_if: Tuned CoxSig or DeepTCSR under 50-trial HPO matches or outperforms SurvTD on non-linear tumor growth and turbofan degradation.

experiments.name: Right-Censored Clinical Telemetry and Alarm Stability Evaluation
experiments.falsifies_if: SurvTD exhibits higher Integrated Brier Score or higher alarm jitter frequency than Dynamic-DeepHit on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3 and PBC.

experiments.name: Negative Control: Interval Scrambling Across Patients
experiments.falsifies_if: Randomizing observation intervals across independent trajectories retains more than 50% of SurvTD discrimination gain over baseline.

experiments.name: Negative Control: Target Network Instant Online Update
experiments.falsifies_if: Setting target network update rate tau to 1.0 maintains stable training and achieves equal concordance without divergence.

statistics.variance_reported: mean ± std over 5 seeds, with paired Wilcoxon signed-rank p-values and 95% bootstrap confidence intervals
statistics.meaningful_delta: >= 0.03 C-index gain, >= 0.03 dynamic AUC gain, >= 20% relative Integrated Brier Score reduction

tuning_parity: All baselines (CoxSig, TCSR with epsilon-regularization, Dynamic-DeepHit, and SurvTD) receive an identical 50-trial Bayesian hyperparameter optimization budget over matching learning rates (1e-4 to 1e-2), hidden dimensions (32 to 128), and weight decays under strict subject-level 5-fold cross-validation.

kill_criteria.abandon_if: If negative control EXP-NC1 retains more than 50% of the concordance gain, or continuous projection EXP-02 fails to beat uniform discretization, C0 is falsified and withdrawn.
If lambda = 1.0 matches lambda = 0.6 within seed noise, the multi-step variance-reduction claim is falsified and C2 is withdrawn.
If Integrated Brier Score on MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3 is worse than Kaplan-Meier baseline, the clinical calibration claim is falsified and C4 is withdrawn.
